name: Skill Foundry
purpose: Provide a thin portable entry point that routes capability-engineering requests into canonical Skill Foundry workflows.
triggers: create or design a reusable Skill/capability
audit or maintain a Skill architecture
non_triggers: ordinary execution of an already-selected domain task with no capability-engineering request
optional_inputs: explicit project context for this Foundry cycle
outputs: Foundry intent and canonical next action
catalog-preflight result when creation is possible
dependencies: Noema governance when operating in repo
stop_conditions: next canonical Foundry stage can start
